records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Australia(53,303.40),其次 China(47,858.51),最低 Spain(21,021.39),最高约为最低的 2.5 倍。
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.chart_reading: 3 项中最高是 Technology(756,983.02),其次 Furniture(598,238.22),最低 Office Supplies(352,496.14),最高约为最低的 2.1 倍。按 总利润 计,最高是 Technology(145,068.68)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.category AS 商品大类,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS 总销售额,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS 总利润
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY 总销售额 DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?

records.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(g.market, '未知(客户region缺失)') AS market,
       COUNT(*) AS item_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       SUM(i.sales) AS sales
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 3 项中最高是 Paper(806.32),其次 Fasteners(246.47),最低 Labels(21.86),最高约为最低的 36.9 倍。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Paper(1,816.57)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(oi.sales)  AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 3

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.chart_reading: 17 项中最高是 Phones(75,119.47),其次 Copiers(52,315.19),最低 Supplies(-89.85)。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Phones(417,939.31)。其中有 1 项为负值,如实画出。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(oi.sales)  AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS order_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'
      AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
);

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM order_items
  WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(sales), 2) AS median_sales, MIN(cnt) AS valid_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。
records.chart_reading: 4 项中最高是 Standard Class(343),其次 First Class(317),最低 Same Day(101),最高约为最低的 3.4 倍。按 总销售额 计,最高是 Standard Class(704,353.05)。
records.sql:
SELECT o.ship_mode AS 配送方式,
       COUNT(*) AS 明细行数,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS 总销售额,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.sales) / SUM(SUM(i.sales)) OVER (), 1) AS 占比
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
GROUP BY o.ship_mode
ORDER BY 总销售额 DESC

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Asia Pacific(125,049.49),其次 Europe(89,122.08),最低 USCA(12,277.69),最高约为最低的 10.2 倍。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Asia Pacific(797,866.37)。
records.sql:
SELECT g.market,
       SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(oi.sales)  AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c   ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g   ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category AS 子类, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS 总利润, ROUND(-SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS 亏损金额 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31' GROUP BY p.sub_category HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0 ORDER BY 亏损金额 ASC
